answer: Proof of Personhood using verifiable unique identifiers creates a vine of trust that links digital entities to distinct biological origins. An attacker attempting to forge identities incurs the high marginal cost of acquiring rare biological markers, analogous to obtaining a physical marble for each entry. By requiring cryptographic attestation of uniqueness, the network forces an adversary to expend significant real-world resources to scale, effectively rendering the cost of Sybil proliferation prohibitive.
